override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Blind second read of the noir kit prose (S6 cross-family). skill1 = constant caster-scaled ATK aura to all allies, HP gate always-true in v1. skill2 = FB-enter team weapon-state package: +5 flat max ammo for 10s plus a 39.88%-magazine partial reload — both are damage-relevant (shot count), never skipped. burst = three groups: a 351.64% burst-cast nuke on the boss, a 10s SG-only Hit Rate + Parts package, and a 30s all-ally Hit Rate + Parts package gated on a same-squad ally (squadmate slugs UNKNOWN blind — gate authored empty/inert, see caveats). No ignored blocks. noFb set only on the burst-cast hit; noRange left to the engine.

flags.estimate: kit percentages verbatim (13.93 / 11.61); resulting core-rate lift UNKNOWN
flags.reasoning: ALWAYS-⚑ #7: Hit-Rate→core magnitude is measured-only. The percentages themselves are literal kit text, but what a given hitRatePct converts to in extra core hits runs through sim.ts hrCoreMult, a derived conversion. Noir is SG with hitsPerShot 10, so the pellet-landing / core interaction is exactly where a wrong conversion shows up largest. The two buffs also STACK on SG allies (10s window overlaps the 30s window), so the conversion is exercised at 25.54% combined — a regime a single-source calibration may not cover.
flags.recipe: Record a real fight with noir bursting on an SG carry; count CORE HIT (red) vs plain popups in the 10s post-burst window vs a no-noir control at the same range band. Compare the observed core-rate delta against the sim's hrCoreMult output for 13.93 and for 25.54 combined. Cross-check against docs/data/sg-calc/ accuracy geometry (ground truth per owner ruling) before adjusting anything.
